responsibility: Declares value_range_equiv, the value-range wrapper used by classic VRP to associate a value_range with a bitmap of equivalent SSA names. The header defines constructors, update/set operations, meet/intersection interfaces, equivalence maintenance helpers, deep-copy/move semantics, and dumping APIs, making it the type-level bridge between the core value-range classes in value-range.h and the VRP-specific equivalence tracking implemented in value-range-equiv.cc.
same_name_distinction: Defines the value_range_equiv class interface and its SSA-equivalence-aware range operations for users such as vr-values; unlike gcc/value-range-equiv.cc, it declares the type, methods, and bitmap-bearing wrapper rather than implementing their behavior.
